description: Settings window (settings_window.rs): core IPC, showing the window once the page has its theme, window theme and webview zoom (the Light/Dark and Interface scale settings apply to it too), dragging it by its title bar, closing it (⌘W), and the native open-folder / confirm dialogs its sections use (one folder for all worktrees, removing a remote, resetting every setting). Updates are checked and installed by the main window; file and git work goes through our own commands, as there.
